tool.title: Draw a document's tables and figures from its ArchiMate data, and check the model against the document's relationship rules
tool.description: For each table an instance's `cat-archimate.config.json` lists under `tables`, rewrites the block's Markdown table from an `archimate-relationship-rules/v1` file (`relationship-rules`: source, relationship, target, note; `relationship-types`: picture, verb, meaning), keeping the caption and footnotes. For each figure under `figures` that names an `svg`, writes the view as SVG (the same drawing as the view's page). For a rules table that names a `model`, reports the rules the model never uses, the relationships no rule covers, the rules ArchiMate's relationship table refuses, and the relationship types the rules use without a meaning. The rules are in charge: nothing is rewritten from the model.

inputs.name: instance
inputs.description: The instance root whose config, models, rules and blocks are read.

inputs.name: check
inputs.description: Write nothing; exit 1 when a block or SVG is not what the data draws.

inputs.name: strict
inputs.description: Also exit 1 when the model has relationships no rule covers, or a rule is one ArchiMate does not allow.

outputs.name: blocks
outputs.description: The rewritten table blocks and figure SVGs, at the paths the config names; the rules check on stdout.

selection.when: When a document's table or figure restates an ArchiMate model (the element and relationship types it uses, the rules between them, a view): generate it instead of typing it, and run `--check` in CI so it cannot drift.
selection.limits: Draws relationship tables and view figures only; element-type tables and glossary tables are not covered yet. Checks a relationship's end types only, not derivation chains or viewpoints.
selection.cost: One parse per model named, one table lookup per relationship; milliseconds. No network, no JVM.
